findings.observation: The deepest-skinned adult face preserves Iani’s round full construction, high cheekbones, softly lidded eyes, strong brow, subtly crooked healed nose, balanced closed mouth, and calm unsmiling expression.

The compact rendering retains Iani’s very-tall-derived, broad-framed sturdy-stocky build with wide shoulders, full torso, substantial leg mass, and plausible softness without adding bodybuilder definition.
Upper arms, forearms, wrists, and empty hands remain proportional to the source’s broad sturdy frame; the grounded closed hands do not show generic chibi inflation.
The long loose dark-brown hair preserves the source center-left part, full crown and side silhouette, heavy gathered mass down the back, natural waves, and absence of accent or shaved area.

The ochre-cream fitted stitched vest, soft full-sleeve shirt, high-waist trousers, offset button closures, narrow reinforced cuffs, flexible brown boots, repeated seam detailing, and one wooden comb visibly stowed in the thigh pocket preserve the verified summon; no tattoo or wearable accessory is added.

At original resolution, the standing figure spans approximately y=142 through y=1410 while the complete top-of-hair-to-chin unit spans approximately y=142 through y=495: about 28 percent of standing height, roughly 3.6 heads total, below the required 32–36 percent / 2.75–3.1-head lock.
Exactly one complete adult chibi appears with the full hair mass and head, both empty hands, both boots, and all clothing and object edges safely inside the canvas.
The planted wide stance, compact silhouette, empty closed hands, large dark hair mass, ochre vest block, pale trousers, and dark boots read clearly as a grounded weaponless ready-idle combat figure.

The practical textile clothing, boots, stitching, and stowed wooden comb remain ordinary mortal belongings; no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text appears.
